label: kizuna_history_a_02
text: The way you conduct yourself in my class and\nthe answers you give to my questions...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_a_03
text: I admit they pique my interest. You are quite the\ninteresting pupil, I must say.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_a_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Tell me, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]—given a
choice,
which
do
you
prefer?\c
Things of old? Or things that are new?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_a_05
text: You would answer “new stuff” to me, your history\nteacher? Ha! You really are a curious one.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_a_06
text: Ah. So you prefer the things of the past, do you?\nThe potential I saw in you was real after all.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_a_07
text: Yes, this one may indeed be of good use to\nme someday...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_a_08
text: Ah, you can disregard that. I was simply thinking\nout loud.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_a_09
text: I enjoyed our little conversation today. You have\nmy thanks, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

text: You became slightly closer with Ms. Raifort!
